title: Iraq frozen 27-recipe evidence coverage
scope: Exactly 27 existing Iraqi recipe snapshots; seven already-inspected photographic specimens; finite additional classes already named in the supplied catalogue or supplied Wikipedia page. No new-era or new-photo search.
sourceWarnings: WorldLicensePlates requested source could not be inspected: browser HTTP redirected HTTPS and returned 502 Certificate verify failed: self-signed certificate; no bypass attempted.
Wikipedia schematics are layout illustrations, not manufacturing die masters.
1982 versus 1988 legacy introduction conflict: Olav/Matriculasdelmundo versus Wikipedia.
2008 versus 2010 bilingual rollout conflict: Wikipedia versus Matriculasdelmundo; keep both until primary evidence.
Rudaw dated 25 April 2022 quotes first new KRG plates issued that day; general private conversions after Eid. Wikipedia transition formula incorrectly differs from Rudaw in digit position.

dispositionDefinitions.matching_class_photograph: At least one of the frozen seven physical photos matches the class and broad layout family; it does not validate every recipe character, province, or default.
dispositionDefinitions.diagram_only: A user-created source diagram supports the category or family, sometimes contradicting current rendering; its lettering is illustration evidence only.
dispositionDefinitions.text_only: The category/color is named in text, without an inspected matching diagram/photo in the frozen scope.
dispositionDefinitions.unsupported: The exact current recipe arrangement is not supported by a matching photograph or source diagram.

photographs.limits: Sharp tapered stems and sharp joins; 9 small closed counter; joined legends also angular. Do not combine with rounded Erbil die as one master.
Diamond 0, teardrop-loop 5, broad two-bowl 4, pointed 8; smoothly rounded stroke ends on country/province words. Raised edges visible.

White on red; no inner divider rules; upper country and lower province left, emblem/IRAQ/hologram middle-left. 5 pointed teardrop loop; 2 wide angular cap, tapering curved stem; 1 pointed top and tapered bottom; 9 long tail. Image overall ratio 2.67:1, not proof of physical dimensions.
Black on yellow, three divided panels. Diamond 0, narrow bowed 1, broad pointed 8. Photograph angled; rectify before extracting widths. Some damage on 9.
White background, compact three-panel layout; upper character tips hidden by rear lamp. Do not reconstruct full glyph outlines from this specimen alone.
0 upper-right diagonal break; round-ended 2 with flat foot, narrow descending 9; tall G squared bowl. IRQ and KR are separate small legend masters. No official font identity established.

L upturned right terminal; 0 upper-right diagonal break; 1 broad foot; 3 angular upper portion and round lower bowl. Plate perimeter rounded, no horizontal divider across serial area. Use for clean glyph studies without importing security marks.
